## Void Deck 0.2.18

**Every button prompt goes monochrome.** The coloured A/B/X/Y hints — Xbox and ROG Ally pads in particular — are now grayscale wherever Steam draws them: as images, as inline SVG, or inside the poster menu. The previous release whitened the bundled art; this covers the prompts Steam paints itself.

**No stray outlines.** The hint bar no longer draws a ring around glyphs it does not own.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.18.zip` from this release.
